name: askUser
description: Ask your human a question and wait for their response. Use this when you need clarification, confirmation, or input that you can't determine on your own. The conversation will pause until they respond.

parameters.name: question
parameters.description: The question to ask your human

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: Optional list of choices for your human to pick from. Max 4 options. Pass as comma-separated string.
